title: Round 4: the round 3 keepers together
about: Round 4 (10-20). In round 3 you kept 'raking light lower (6°)' and 'finer raking detail' on both looks, each on its own. Both are now in the two built-in looks together (L01, F01); this round checks the pair. L = 'Favourite, side lamp left', F = 'Favourite, from the left'. 02 and 03 are round 3's single changes again (lower only, finer only), to compare against. 04 goes lower still (5°), 05 finer still (smoothing 0.008 instead of 0.01, fine texture 0.65 instead of 0.5), 06 both. Hold the picture to flip to 01 (for 02–06) or to the photo (for 01). Rendered without the guard, like round 3, so only the raking light differs between versions (how the guard should fix too-dark or too-bright pictures is the other review page).
